Finding the outliers of a fitted model

Source: R/diagnose_outliers.R
diagnose_outliers.Rd

diagnose_outliers() finds the observations that a model fits least well. {infernet} holds the generic, so that {goldfish} and other packages register methods for their own fits on the same generic, and a user calls one function for any model. It has a method for an infernetMrqapFit, from estimate_mrqap(), which finds the dyads with the most extreme residuals.

diagnose_changepoints(), diagnose_onset(), and diagnose_confusion() are diagnostics of the same family.

Usage

diagnose_outliers(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
diagnose_outliers(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'infernetMrqapFit'
diagnose_outliers(x, method = c("Hampel", "IQR", "Top"), threshold = 3, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted model, such as an infernetMrqapFit from estimate_mrqap().

...

Arguments for a method. Not used by the methods here.

method

How to flag an outlier: "Hampel" (the default), "IQR", or "Top", as in {goldfish}.

threshold

The number of scaled median absolute deviations for "Hampel", the number of half interquartile ranges for "IQR", or the number of dyads to flag for "Top".

Value

For an infernetMrqapFit, an object of class infernetOutliers: a tibble of one row for each dyad of the model, with its sender and receiver, its network for a list of networks or a panel, its reporter for a cognitive social structure, its .residual, whether it is an outlier, and a label of the dyad where it is one. Its attributes method and threshold record how it was made. The print shows the outliers only.

Details

For an infernetMrqapFit, diagnose_outliers() reads the Pearson residual of each dyad of the observed model: the residual of a gaussian model, and the residual over its standard deviation for another family.

  • "Hampel" flags a dyad whose residual is further than threshold times the scaled median absolute deviation from the median residual. A network has no order of its dyads, so the Hampel identifier reads all the dyads together, not in a moving window.

  • "IQR" flags a dyad whose residual is further than threshold / 2 times the interquartile range from the median residual.

  • "Top" flags the threshold dyads with the largest absolute residuals.

The residuals come from the observed model, which the permutations do not change, so the result says nothing about the p-values.

See also

Other evaluating functions: diagnose_confusion(), diagnose_residuals, diagnose_time, evaluate_likelihood, test_fit, test_parameter()

Examples

fit <- estimate_mrqap(weight ~ ego(Citations) + alter(Citations),
                      manynet::ison_networkers, times = 5)
diagnose_outliers(fit, method = "Top", threshold = 5)
#> # Outliers of a poisson MRQAP of weight
#> # 5 of 992 dyads flagged by Top, with a threshold of 5
#> 
#> # A tibble: 5 × 4
#>   sender        receiver      .residual outlier
#>   <chr>         <chr>             <dbl> <lgl>  
#> 1 Doug White    Lin Freeman        76.8 TRUE   
#> 2 Barry Wellman Lin Freeman       134.  TRUE   
#> 3 Lin Freeman   Doug White        110.  TRUE   
#> 4 Lin Freeman   Russ Bernard       81.0 TRUE   
#> 5 Lin Freeman   Barry Wellman      93.7 TRUE
